en: Rūpīduka (The Dyad of the Possessing Form)
Dependent on a material phenomenon, a non-material phenomenon arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are nine;

under object condition, three; under predominance condition, five ... pe ... under mutuality condition, six ... pe ... under prenascence and repetition conditions, one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition, nine. (Full detail for all.)
